_about: fieldkit hog thresholds. Override any key in state/hog/thresholds.json (same names). Every rule is a number here, never a judgment call.
pileup_fixes: restart Claude Desktop (or end that claude session) when no session is working
find who started them (pgrep -alP {pid}) and close what nobody uses
_service_classes: orphan classes that outlive the session that started them: never stopped as orphans; a registered one that died is reported with its restart line (2026-10-28: the hog stopped the L15's link listener and the cable was deaf for 54 minutes)

service_classes.link-listener: fieldkit peers link restart (keep-alive: fieldkit peers link keepalive install)
service_classes.link-relay: fieldkit peers link relay doctor, then start fieldkit peers link relay listen as the relay session's background command
